comment: Ownership map for the future private Cloud overlay (backenly/backenly-cloud).
PUBLIC IS THE DEFAULT. A path listed here is one the private overlay is
ALLOWED to own; everything not listed belongs to the public product and the
overlay may never write it. Enforced by scripts/verify-overlay-boundary.ts.
Ownership is whole-directory. A private subsystem gets a directory of its
own so the overlay only ever ADDS files, and never has to overwrite one the
public repository tracks. prisma/seed-billing.ts is the single deliberate
file-level exception: billing seed data has no directory to call its own.
Listing a path here does NOT make it private today. Phases 6 and 7 perform
the actual removals. Until then the files below are still tracked publicly
and are recorded in `transition.grandfathered`.
Phase 4 grandfather list: public files that already live under a path the
overlay will eventually own. They are legal ONLY because Phase 6 (back
office) and Phase 7 (org + fleet control plane) have not run yet.
This list may SHRINK, never grow. A public file under a private-owned path
that is not named here is a new ownership violation and fails the build.
Phase 6/7 delete these files and prune the matching entries; when the list
reaches zero, CI moves to --strict and this key is deleted outright.
It is an exact file list, not a count, on purpose: Phase 1 established that
"the same number of failures" is not evidence that the same things failed.
